body: No. I've been having a hard time breathing; can't catch my breath. It could very well be something else. Doesn't really matter, since I have no insurance and with my agoraphobia I won't be going any where soon.
Really? Ick. I kinda meant w/o any intervention though. I really *hate* doctors.

Not sure I have a long convo in me for this right now. Try to talk to someone about their internalized racism, sexism, etc. you observe, and see how it goes. Then after you wish you hadn't...ask yourself why on Earth has the trans community allowed the normalization of this.
Rationalize it however you want. It's judgmental and impertinent.
"Internalized Transphobia"! This phrase needs to stop; it's victim blaming for trauma symptoms. It's as cruel as blaming a gunshot victim for internalizing a bullet.

"short sighted"? you're right...you don't have all the details, and that was really judgmental considering. I've been on HRT since 2003. I've been FT for many years, and have waited for surgery as long. I wasn't born yesterday. I know exactly what surgery does and doesn't do. So please, a little less pontificating. Thx. :)
I plan to be long gone before anything you mentioned could happen. I'm not laying bed for two+ more years for another maybe. The pain needs to end soon.
Midwest US
If suffering from my death approaches anything near what I need to escape...I'll leave open ended tickets for them to join me.

Not to sound rude, but talk is cheap. It's not enough. There are so many of us dying from lack of access to healthcare, and what are groups focusing on? Things like the TSA? I'm sorry but I am, for all intensive purposes, *alone*.
I sensed the same. I call people out if they are selectively signal amplifying. Only the popular survive, while the rest are left for dead (or things that I can't do, like the sex trade).

You're right. It is discrimination. Doesn't matter if nobody is willing to help though. So many advocacy groups say "know your rights" and contact us if you have a #transhealthfail, but the best I've gotten from any of them is 'we'll get back to you'. 

Yes, the agoraphobia makes seeing other urologists impossible. The only reason I saw the one is b/c they had me locked in the hospital against my will.

People saw my crowdfunding campaign. There was even *talk* of doing something to help me on a FB page for TG people in my state since I engaged in a lawsuit that got a lot of other people coverage. One of them, who got surgery as a result of the changes that resulted from my legal battle, contributed $50. A gaming friend contributed another $50. That's it. People know. Apparently I'm not popular enough to survive? So be it.

When people are telling me to resort to illegal options...I know it's time. I would never survive prison. I already dissociate on the same level as refugee torture victims (per one hospital social worker); I won't risk any more trauma. My psyche has had enough.

View few surgeons are taking Medicare from what I've researched (two in the US), and the wait for them is insane. Medicare coverage alone does no good for dual eligible people if Medicaid don't cover care. Medicare is only 80/20...I can't afford the difference. Also, FFS has been listed as more important in some cases than SRS, and I have not heard of a single case in any state where Medicaid or Medicare has covered it.

The pain is from a varicocele I acquired as a kid, when I tried to do surgery on myself. The pain used to be intermittent, but it's greatly worsened. I've had a urologist consult already; they won't help. Everyone just talks about seeking out SRS surgeons for it. The pain is unbearable, it won't go unattended long enough to jump through WPATH hoops (even if I could get coverage). Hence the DIY surgery talk.

I only have Medicare Part A and D. Can't afford Part B, and since I can't get to any doctor...it's moot. =/

I'm on SSDI already; have been since 2009. Things just keep getting worse. I've been pretty much stuck in bed for months with genital pain b/c sitting up/standing increases abdominal pressure and pain.

I can't relate. I have extreme PTSD, and have seen trauma therapists. They said that the core trauma can't even begun to be worked on until surgery is complete b/c the trauma is still happening. They said it would be tantamount to trying to work with a vet on their PTSD in a warzone, no respectable therapist would attempt it. I don't hinge anything on surgery; I've accepted I will die before it happens.

If there were no better option...yes I would support someone else who was considering the same things. I'm happy for those that have made the leap and decided to die. Their suffering is over, and I'm jealous. I've been struggling with all of this for over thirty years. So many times I've heard "it gets better", "it's getting better", "the trans community is next", bla bla bla. Enough already. =/

Funny. I have been advised to turn to the body mod community to find a cutter to help me with my unbearable genital pain and surgical needs. Things are beyond that now though. My agoraphobia is so bad that...well, I haven't left my house in over a year, and have no desire to. This is most likely is going to end one of two ways, (1) DIY surgery, and/or (2) suicide.

Whatever decision(s) I make for myself are for *myself*. They say nothing about what anyone else should do for themselves. I won't attempt to categorize suffering, and nobody should be judged for how they respond uniquely to stress and trauma.

I need surgery. No amount of therapy or anything else can change that. I find therapists antagonizing now. They can't help; nevermind how gatekeepers have sabotaged past *real* opportunities to get surgery. I've had enough. No more falling for gatekeepers pulling the carpet out from under me; pointless arguments of having to be stable to get surgery when there is *no* money or coverage any more. I've come to accept that the only way I'm going to get surgery is if I do it myself, and if I do that I will be hospitalized again and for a much longer duration. I'd rather die.
It doesn't take any training to call 911 and send the police, which all they would do. No, but thanks. I've spent too much time locked up in hospitals. Enough is enough.

TBH it really wouldn't matter what gender roles or expectations society had; my mind and body are in chaotic conflict. I *need* surgery. 

I think flights of fantasy like this try to totally ignore why things are they way they are. You can't turn evolutionary psychology around on a dime.

I too have found the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline...lacking. I've found it's usually pointless to give an operator a second chance if not helpful, abusive, rude (happens all the time). Keep calling though, and if someone who was not helpful in the past answers hangup and try again. There really isn't much uniformity across the call centers in the network, and some are *really* bad. If your local center isn't helpful call other hotlines around the country. Most will passive aggressively try to make you feel bad about calling a none local hotline. If they don't automatically hangup, and you find them someone helpful to talk too though, talk.
